resources.string: NFC handoff and camera tags
Tap devices to transfer GPS duty, or write a camera tag
AlphaGPS camera handoff
Keep both devices unlocked with this screen open. Pair each device with the camera first. NFC transfers a task; location data still goes to the camera over Bluetooth.
This device has no NFC. Existing Bluetooth and location features remain available.
Turn on NFC to use these actions.
Open NFC settings
This device cannot emulate an NFC card. It can receive a handoff or read camera tags if its NFC reader supports them.
Could not activate NFC. Check NFC settings, then try again.
NFC reading or writing timed out and has stopped. Choose an action to try again.
Pair this device with the camera in AlphaGPS first. An NFC tag cannot replace Sony Bluetooth pairing.
Allow location and nearby devices before receiving or connecting. Then repeat the action.
Permissions updated. Repeat the receive or connect action.
Allow location and nearby devices
Turn on Bluetooth before receiving or connecting.
Turn on system location before receiving or connecting, then repeat the action.
Ready to offer this camera for two minutes.
The offer expired. Create a new offer to try again.
Pausing this camera and closing its connections…
This camera is paused on this device, including automatic reconnection. The receiver must still connect to the camera. To use this device again, enable the camera in the device list.
The handoff was not confirmed. Check this camera in the device list. The receiver will not start automatically.
This camera may already be paused. Closing or cancelling does not restore sending; check the device list and enable it manually if needed.
Offer selected camera
Receive from another device
On the other device choose Receive, then bring the NFC antennas together. Reading an offer does not stop this device. Keep this screen open for the confirmation tap.
Bring the devices together to read the offered camera. You will confirm before the sender is paused.
Tap the same sender again and hold still until confirmed. The sender pauses first, then this device requests a camera connection.
No active AlphaGPS offer. Keep the sender unlocked on its offer screen.
This is not a compatible NFC handoff device. Camera tags use Read camera tag.
The sender pause was not confirmed. Keep the sender screen open and tap it again. This device has not started sending.
Camera connection requested. Check its GPS and connection state in the device list. This does not confirm GPS in photo metadata.
Camera tags contain only a camera identifier. They do not pause another sender. Writing replaces the tag contents; the tag stays writable.
Write selected camera to tag (overwrite)
Read camera tag
Hold a writable NFC tag against this device. Its current contents will be replaced.
Hold an AlphaGPS camera tag against this device.
Camera tag written. You can attach it near the camera. Metal may require an on-metal NFC tag.
No supported AlphaGPS camera record was found.
This tag is read-only. Use a writable tag.
This tag has too little space for the camera record.
This tag cannot store an NDEF camera record.
NFC contact was interrupted. Keep the devices or tag close and try again. If the sender already paused, it stays paused.
The NFC action could not finish. Check the camera state and try again.
Use this camera on this device?
Camera: %1$s\nConfirm, then tap the same sender again. The sender will pause this camera and this device will enable GPS sending for it.
Camera: %1$s\nThis will enable GPS sending on this device. A tag cannot stop another phone; stop its location link first.

Cancel
